name: CARDLIKE
author: Addicting Games
description:
Cardlike is a high-stakes deck-builder that blends fast-paced gameplay with strategic depth while remaining easy to pick up.

 

Choose your strategy by creating unique original combos and dominate using your intellect.

 

Core Gameplay
Match Card Hands - Build the ultimate hand to score big!
Crazy Combos - Discover powerful card interactions and go infinite!
Optimize - Refine your deck to surpass target scores!
Win - Outsmart the RNG and secure the run!

 

Features
200+ unique cards and consumables!
Infinite replayability!
